testResults.name: zig-native-gates
testResults.result: Zig 0.16.0: format clean; 13/13 native tests pass including symbol/OSI backtracking, deterministic sha256 v5 IDs, i128 scale-18 fixed point with Python str(Decimal)-identical canonical text, and TradeRow canonical JSON

testResults.name: python-native-bridge
testResults.command: uv run --extra dev pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/harness/native
testResults.result: 17 passed with the built library: FFI parity vs Python core, byte-identity vs codecs._row, pyarrow Arrow C Data Interface bridge (pyarrow 25.0.1, pa.Array._import_from_c), loader ABI validation; absence behavior: 6 passed / 11 skipped with NativeCoreUnavailable build-instruction message, default pytest stays green without a prior build

testResults.name: repository-wide-quality-gates
testResults.result: Repository-wide gates passed with 1087 tests after wave integration

limitations: ABI version pinned at 1 (NATIVE_CORE/loader must bump together); dynamic library artifact now emitted to zig-out/bin (Windows) and zig-out/lib
Docker runtime stage must carry the native artifact for bridge tests to run in-image; CI pytest leg likewise (integration follow-up for T184 wave)
